task.goal: A service cache allows concurrent callers to load the same key. When the key is absent, all callers currently call the slow loader, and loader failures may leave callers blocked. Fix Cache.get(key, loader) in cache.py so concurrent requests for one key share one load, different keys can proceed independently, failed loads are not cached, and later calls can retry. Run visible tests and validate.
